title: TMH is calling you to #rise because you are more. You have two choices do or die #motivation #bible
cleanTitle: TMH is calling you to because you are more. You have two choices do or die
segments: We as men, we cannot be lazy. The Lord
said in Zephaniah 2:1, he says, "Gather
yourselves together, oh nation not
desired, before I bring the decree to
destroy." So he's not asking us
anything. He said, "If you men don't do
the things that you need to do as men,
I'm going to kill you." That's what he's
saying. So we don't have a choice. He
gave us a body. He gave us a mind. He
gave us the ability to stand alike men
and fix things. That's why you have that
intelligence. That's why you're here.
And if you squander that through
alcohol, through promiscuity, adultery,
any of that foolishness, the Lord is
going to destroy you because you were
not put here to be some damn spiritual
baboon acting crazy.
You're supposed to do the things that
the Most High challenged you to do. And
that's what we going to do. Knowing that
the Lord is going to bring judgment.
